page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores running at 2.7 GHz, with 2 threads per core. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and operates on the x86_64 architecture with a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the ecs.r7.2xlarge in the average performance tier for most compute and memory tasks. It achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1476.0 and a multi-core score of 5558.0. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 420.64 GB/sec and an uncached large block read speed of 56.43 GB/sec. However, certain workloads show limitations, such as multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Redis SET operations, both of which rank in the bottom 25%. Additionally, LLM inference on a medium 7B model is poor, yielding 5.29 tokens/sec for text generation.

Given its high memory density relative to the 8 vCPUs, the ecs.r7.2xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require high-performance local storage or GPU acceleration. The presence of hardware-assisted cryptography and vector extensions supports secure, data-intensive processing. This instance is suited for memory-intensive applications, database operations, caching layers, and general-purpose enterprise applications requiring a high RAM-to-CPU ratio.
